name: Flambeau Ridge – first
summary: Chippewa County fire tower on Flambeau Ridge, begun 1931 and moved on the mountain in 1935-36; the Wisconsin list marks the 'first' entry gone, with no removal date found.
design: Planned as a 100-foot steel observation tower with a six-foot steel house at the top
status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association's Wisconsin list marks 'Flambeau Ridge – first' as Gone. A second Flambeau Ridge entry on the same list is marked Standing. The list does not say which structure each entry describes.
agency: Wisconsin Conservation Commission (per 1931 to 1936 newspaper reports)

events.note: A newspaper report dated October 11, 1931 says the foundation for a 100-foot steel observation tower had been laid and the tower was being built as part of the reforestation program. No completion date is given.
A May 1932 newspaper report says the tower man installed there was on the job and had signaled for help for fires near Foster Lake.
A September 1935 report says the tower was being removed and moved farther north to a higher point on the mountain.
An April 1936 report says the tower was in its new location and ready for the fire permit season.
